d: The position is responsible for assisting in daily warehouse operations including receiving, storing, scanning, and dispatching goods while ensuring proper handling and inventory accuracy in the distribution center.
q: 1-2 years of experience working in a warehouse or distribution center environment in a similar role or related position is preferred.
Proficiency in managing inventory levels and conducting regular stock checks.
Basic knowledge of warehouse operations, barcode scanning, and inventory handling.
r: Assist in receiving, unpacking, and organizing inbound shipments according to the standard operating procedures.
Support in inventory movement, product scanning, and shelving based on barcodes and category requirements.
Perform manual handling tasks such as lifting, loading/unloading, and packing of goods as per brand and dispatch instructions.
Maintain cleanliness and safety in the warehouse zone assigned.
Coordinate with senior DC staff to ensure timely and accurate fulfillment of outbound orders.
Follow proper documentation and labelling practices to support inventory tracking and minimize errors.
Report damaged or missing stock to supervisors and follow instructions for corrective action.
